integrity: The proof uses the published positive beta(H) spectral criterion and derives the noncommuting singular-value lower bound by an explicit min-max argument; no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns positive scalar-plus-compact sources and positive compact-difference repairs. Two plausible related papers were inspected only through abstracts; historical priority is not settled. Finite diagnostics are not an infinite-dimensional proof.
title: Sharp singular-value tails for finite-exception repairs of positive norm-attaining operators
